description: This file contains step definitions for Cucumber-based BDD scenarios related to login functionalities in the OrangeHRM project. It defines methods for setting up the base URL, performing login actions, and verifying the dashboard display, all annotated with Cucumber annotations and containing comments about usage and limitations.

classes.name: LoginSteps
classes.description: Defines Cucumber step definitions for login scenarios, managing scenario context variables, and providing informative comments about the test execution and limitations.

methods.name: orangehrm_is_available_at
methods.description: Stores the base URL for the scenario context; set via the Given step.

methods.name: i_login_as_with_password
methods.description: Performs the login step by storing username and verifying input validity; intended as a placeholder without actual browser actions.

methods.name: i_should_see_the_dashboard
methods.description: Verifies that a user is logged in by checking the scenario context; acts as a placeholder assertion.
